## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm -r typecheck` and `pnpm -r test` pass locally
- [ ] For a change to `apps/workspace` or `apps/extension`: actually ran it and clicked through
      the affected flow, not just passing tests (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] For a change touching `packages/evidence-interchange`: read `SPEC.md` first, the
      `tracepack-evidence` contract is frozen as of v1
- [ ] Signed the [CLA](../CLA.md) if this touches an AGPLv3-covered path (see `LICENSING.md`
      for which paths those are), not needed for changes to the Apache-2.0 packages
